bible.title: Charter of the Old Watch
bible.kernel: A city steward hires the company to fetch a sworn truce charter from the forest and return it, touching an elf priest who may join them.

cast.name: Gulena Thistledown
cast.who: A city steward from the fort who handles border dealings and pays bluntly.
cast.want: to have the sworn truce charter delivered to her at the fort

cast.name: Firthaedal
cast.who: An old forest elder born in the grove who keeps the truce's sealed charter.
cast.want: to keep the sworn charter at his grove

cast.name: Odreth
cast.who: An ugly elf priest from the Western Wood who hides at the forest's edge and knows the elder's routes.

bible.situation: The fort keeps a sworn truce with the Western Forests sealed by a charter. The charter rests with the forest elder Firthaedal who lives under an avalanche-scarred ridge. Gulena Thistledown fears the truce will break if the charter is not kept at the fort and hires a mercenary band to fetch it. Odreth knows the routes into the elder's grove and has been hiding near the Dell.
bible.goal: to retrieve the sworn truce charter and return it to Gulena Thistledown at the fort
arc: Ride to Singing Dell, the hollow Gulena named, and search the ruined watch for leads → yields: Odreth, found sheltering at the Dell's rim and willing to guide.
Follow Odreth into the avalanche-scarred grove he points to and seek the elder there → yields: Firthaedal, found alive at the grove, guarding the sealed charter and refusing to hand it over.
Escort Firthaedal and the sealed charter back to the fort using Odreth's guidance, and outwit or force Firthaedal so the company can hand the sworn truce charter to Gulena Thistledown at the fort
tensions: an avalanche-scarred approach can strand the party and the elder
forest kin resent outward passage and may ambush a returning group
Firthaedal will not surrender the charter without clear proof the truce will be honored
openDirections: Winter snows and a sudden ridge fall can cut the grove off, killing Firthaedal and ending the truce whether the company acts or not
bible.stakeIfLost: If the charter fails to reach the fort the fort's right to the winter timber convoy will be revoked, cutting off its licensed harvest.
bible.arrival: came back a second time · asked for the boss by name

shipped.title: Search the ruined watch at Singing Dell
shipped.situation: A city steward, Gulena Thistledown, came back a second time and asked for the boss by name, and she wants the sworn truce charter delivered to her at the fort, the coin comes at the finish with the pick of what the job turns up. She says the fort's right to the winter timber convoy will be revoked if the charter does not reach the fort. An elder plans to keep the sworn charter at his grove. She says the charter must be brought to her and will not take the chair offered.
shipped.job: Ride to Singing Dell and search the ruined watch for leads
